content: We need to find a template that when applied to the given molecule (the initial molecule) reproduces the carbonyl-ene reaction retrosynthetically (i.e., break to precursors). The task: return mapped_rxn and template_id (integer). We need to search template catalog for appropriate transformation. The criteria: functional_groups_broken: ketones, C-C double bonds (since forward reaction consumes carbonyl and alkene). functional_groups_formed: aliphatic hydroxyls, five-membered rings (product). Also bonds broken/formed: C=C to C-C, C=O to C-O. We attempted search but got empty.
